edges.claim: A modern smartphone requires integrated computation; SoCs combine major computing functions.
Cellular smartphones require radio communication hardware.
A portable smartphone requires an energy source.
The smartphone interface requires a display system.
An SoC is an integrated circuit containing multiple functional blocks.
Integrated circuits are built from semiconductor devices including transistors.
Transistors depend on semiconductor behaviour.
Manufacturing transistors requires microfabrication processes.
Photolithography is a core patterning technique in microfabrication.
Silicon became the dominant material platform for modern semiconductor electronics; other semiconductors also exist.
High-purity silicon for semiconductor use requires controlled crystalline material.
Semiconductor-grade crystalline silicon starts from highly purified material.
Industrial purification depends on chemical process knowledge and quantitative measurement.
Microfabrication requires precise dimensional and process control.
Radio electronics depend on electrical science and circuitry.
Electrochemical cells rely on electrical and electrochemical principles.
Electrical science advanced through instruments and quantitative measurement.
Precision instruments historically depended on increasingly capable material and metalworking processes; this is a historical influence, not a strict technical requirement.
Metal production requires access to ores and extraction processes.
Many early extraction and processing routes relied on controlled heat, though mining itself does not universally require fire.
Copper processing is a major branch of metallurgical capability.

meta.note: Edges are intentionally typed. 'requires' is stronger than 'enables' or 'alternative_support'. Historical influence is kept separate from technical necessity.
